policy: Report each source, genre and input condition separately. Essays and conversations are both useful. Do not treat one as a proxy for the other or pool them into an unqualified accuracy score.

corpora.selection: Eight hash-selected articles per topical folder at pinned commit; 104 topical samples. sample-records also contains About/resources and Kemdict evidence, which the source/category selector must exclude.
corpora.leakage: Already inspected for source quality. Not an unseen holdout. No production extraction from these artifacts. Before ranking evaluation, measure overlap with production sources by document and normalized passage; copied/rephrased Wikipedia content requires lineage review.
corpora.limitations: Audit-ready prose, not yet annotated IME targets. Useful for terminology, names, longer phrasing and punctuation. Human review status varies. Do not infer conversational frequency, generate gold readings from the decoder under test, or call filename membership typing accuracy.

corpora.selection: Reuse the pinned GUM test export and existing per-row genre labels; 1,285 rows. Retain its source manifest rather than re-extracting a favorable sample.
corpora.leakage: Previously evaluated during vocabulary changes; suitable for regression, not fresh generalization claims. No GUM data enters context training. Recheck text overlap if future production sources change.
corpora.limitations: English only. The 193 conversation rows and 60 essay rows are separate denominators. A typed reconstruction of spoken dialogue is not recorded touchscreen behavior. Source rights remain governed by the original corpus notices.

corpora.selection: Existing 13,014-row core corpus; preserve en-dev/en-test, zh-dev/zh-test and moe-glyph labels from its detailed manifest.
corpora.leakage: Context training uses separate upstream train splits, but these development/test rows have already informed regression work. Do not market them as unseen. Shared upstream source lineage also limits independence.
corpora.limitations: The historical folder name conversation-ranking does not make Chinese Wikipedia-derived spans natural conversation. Glyph reference probes and derived phonetic queries are not sentence-level accuracy. No Taiwan conversational representativeness is established.

corpora.selection: Hash-selected 16 queries per existing corpus/pack/input-mode group, with full, half and first-letter variants (1488 queries). Native acceptance uses 32 hash-selected rows per legacy group (352). Phone uses the first selected triple in each group (93 queries). Seeds and original source digests are in corpus.json and tools/make_latency_corpus.py.
corpora.leakage: Reuses inspected regression sources and source-derived dictionary queries. Suitable for timing and exact output parity only; not a fresh language-quality holdout. No production entries, source decisions or ranking weights changed.
corpora.limitations: Hash sampling is per source/mode, not traffic weighted. No natural conversation or essay representativeness claim; broad existing source groups remain separate. Callback timing excludes touch dispatch, final layout and display refresh. Synthetic prefix variants are not observed human typing errors.

corpora.selection: Frozen hash selection by complete source document, then occurrences: eight GUM conversation documents, four GUM essays, two previously audited Taiwan.md essays per category, and 128 everyday entries per third-language pack. 3922 complete, partial and deterministic transposition queries. See coverage-manifest.json and make_mode_corpus.py.
corpora.leakage: GUM train/dev exports are not MinIME training data: they were newly acquired and frozen after mode design, before candidate outputs, for a first-use holdout. Now evaluated and not fresh for future changes. Taiwan.md was already audited and has possible Wikipedia lineage. Chinese reading resolution uses original McBopomofo annotations shared with the production lexicon, not decoder output; this limits independence. Dictionary probes are explicitly seen-source retrieval.
corpora.limitations: No accessible, permission-cleared Taiwan Mandarin conversation sample or independent Japanese/Taiwanese conversation/essay corpus was acquired. Chinese prose excludes unresolved or ambiguous reference readings and outside-window spans; counts are explicit. GUM input uses source-prefix words as accepted context. Coverage uses fully visible whole-input candidates and measured Android font/viewport sizes, not fixed top-N rank; timing uses a separate uncached phone test.

corpora.selection: All 504 numbered headwords from pinned MOE beginner handout; complete inventory frozen before sidecar change.
corpora.leakage: Previously unseen handout now inspected for extraction. It shares editorial lineage with Taiwan dictionaries; no independent language-accuracy or spelling-consensus claim. No handout data enters production.
corpora.limitations: Printed romanization has damaged PDF extraction and is not gold. Han inventory tests spelling presence, not sense or dialect correctness; duplicate spellings are retained by numbered item.

corpora.selection: Every shipped authored beginner headword/variant, shortest tone-free source alias, complete/prefix/initial input. Frozen 15,489 queries for 5,163 outputs.
corpora.leakage: Targets and keys are from the existing production source; this verifies retrieval and paired metadata, not language accuracy or new independent holdout coverage.
corpora.limitations: Does not measure sense correctness, spontaneous conversation, dialect coverage or spelling consensus. Rank is within the bounded optional dictionary results, not pixel visibility.

corpora.selection: All eligible source-common kana readings, plus a fixed hash-selected 1,024-reading partial/initial sample; frozen before generation outcomes.
corpora.leakage: Targets and aliases are production-source records. No independent conversation, essay, accuracy or fresh-holdout claim.
corpora.limitations: Source commonness is imperfect. Does not measure sentence conversion, sense correctness, modern usage or spontaneous human typing.

corpora.selection: All supported source headwords and aligned variants, full tone-free queries plus 2048 deterministic hash-selected half-reading probes. Frozen before importer expansion. Reproduced by tools/audit_focused_dictionaries.py.
corpora.leakage: Production-source targets measure source retrieval only; not independent conversation or essay accuracy.
corpora.limitations: No lexical frequency, sense, spontaneous conversation, spelling consensus or grammar evaluation. Query variants remain grouped by source ID.

corpora.selection: All 1555 recovered spellings under complete tone-free input, plus SHA256(query) first 8 hex digits modulo 128 controls. Half-reading probes use fixed modulo 8 selection. Full source union inventory is exhaustive; runtime probes are bounded and frozen before ranks.
corpora.leakage: Targets and aliases share production sources. Not independent language accuracy or a fresh holdout.
corpora.limitations: Commonness, dialect coverage, modern conversation and intended sense are not measured. Five formerly reachable partial targets are displaced by recovered entries.

corpora.selection: All 546 distinct shipped POJ ASCII outputs equal to a normalized reading, plus 546 marked reading/output controls selected by SHA256 order before observing results. Frozen during the preceding diagnostic on ab296aa.
corpora.leakage: Production-source retrieval probes; not independent language accuracy, commonness or a fresh holdout.
corpora.limitations: Does not measure source omissions, usage frequencies, spontaneous conversation, essay quality, partial-input coverage, or physical touch latency.
